title: Unity Global Variables
tagline: An open-source system to share variables across scripts and scenes using ScriptableObjects.
overview: Global values live in ScriptableObject assets that any script can read or change, across scenes, directly from the editor.
Inspired by Ryan Hipple's talk [Game Architecture with Scriptable Objects](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=raQ3iHhE_Kk) (Unite Austin 2017). Usage is documented in the README.

highlights.title: Designer-friendly
highlights.text: Tweak values from the editor without touching code.

highlights.title: Persistence
highlights.text: Save and load variable states between play sessions.

highlights.title: Fewer dependencies
highlights.text: Replace direct script references with shared variables.

learnings: Reusable systems with ScriptableObjects and managing data across scenes.
Improving the workflow of designers with real-time editing of values.
